defaults.x: Accessible & Ethical, Minimalism & Swiss Style, Editorial Grid / Magazine
defaults.d: none needed: enquiries land in an inbox
defaults.c: Deep restrained brand colour on a warm neutral ground; one accent for the enquiry button
defaults.a: Book a first call or send an enquiry
defaults.t: Regulator and registration number, named people with credentials, fee shape, short case notes with permission, complaints route
defaults.b: First-call booking; fixed-fee quote for standard work

rows: Legal Services
solicitor, law firm, lawyer, conveyancing, family law, employment, fees, consultation
Name what you handle and the fee shape (fixed, hourly or free first call). Show the regulator, registration number and complaints route, and write the process as steps the client takes.
Accountant / Bookkeeper
accountant, bookkeeping, vat, payroll, self assessment, small business, year end, software
Sell fixed monthly packages with named software support. Give a price list for common jobs and the qualification body, then let people book an intro call.
Tax Preparation
tax return, self assessment, deadline, hmrc, refund, documents, personal tax, filing
Put the filing deadline and a fixed price on the first screen, with a checklist of documents to gather. Show how documents are sent securely and who files.

rows.a: Get a fixed price for my return

rows: Consultant / Coach
consultant, coach, business coaching, workshop, strategy, programme, discovery call
State who you help and the result with a source. Offer a short discovery call and a clear format and price for engagements, and show client names with permission.
Life Coach
life coach, coaching, goals, career change, confidence, sessions, accountability
Describe how a session runs and what coaching is not. Show training, a fee per session or package, and a no-obligation first chat.
B2B Service
b2b, professional services, agency, consulting, enterprise, contract, retainer, outsourcing
Say who the client is, the problem and how engagements are priced. Show named case studies and the team, and make a call easy for a busy buyer.
Creative Agency
creative agency, branding, design studio, campaign, clients, case studies, portfolio
Lead with three projects told with problem and result, and let the agency's own taste show. Avoid a template look: the site is the first sample of the work.
Marketing Agency
marketing agency, seo, ads, social, growth, retainer, results, campaigns
Show named results with dates and the method behind them. Publish packages or a minimum spend and say who will work on the account.
Travel/Tourism Agency
travel agent, holidays, tours, itinerary, booking, destinations, tailor made, atol
Show the protection scheme and licence number early. Offer tailor-made enquiries with dates and budget, and photos from your own trips.

rows.t: Bonding or licence number, named travel advisers, real trip photos, complaints route

rows: Insurance Platform
insurance, quote, cover, policy, claim, compare, premium, renewals
Make the quote path short and show what is covered in words, not only icons. Explain the claims steps and show regulator details.

rows.t: Regulator number, claim steps, policy wording link, complaints route
